description: This file defines the class DefaultEnforcementConfig, which implements the EnforcementConfig interface for configuring enforcement settings in the Eclipse Ditto Concierge service. It manages parameters such as askTimeout, bufferSize, and globalLiveResponseDispatching, and provides methods for instantiation and property access.

classes.name: DefaultEnforcementConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing EnforcementConfig for managing enforcement-related configuration parameters in the Eclipse Ditto Concierge service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultEnforcementConfig based on the provided Config object, applying fallback and validation.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the askTimeout parameter representing the maximum duration to wait for an enforcement answer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the bufferSize parameter indicating the size of internal buffers.

methods.name: shouldDispatchLiveResponsesGlobally
methods.description: Indicates whether live responses should be dispatched globally.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on askTimeout, bufferSize, and globalLiveResponseDispatching.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the configuration parameters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration instance.
